name: Outsy
description: A curated discovery platform that helps users find and decide on outing locations in under 60 seconds, eliminating decision fatigue.

details.overview: Outsy is a high-performance web application engineered to solve decision fatigue by providing instant, curated outing recommendations. Built on a modern Next.js 15 Server Components architecture with Tailwind CSS v4, the platform ensures rapid content delivery and a highly responsive, mobile-first user experience.
technicalHighlights: Implemented a Server Components-first architecture in Next.js 15 to minimize client-side bundle size and push heavy rendering to the server.
Engineered a scalable, schema-driven mock data strategy that perfectly mirrors a planned Supabase relational database.
Developed a rigorous mobile-first UI using capability-based media queries to resolve complex touch device interaction edge cases like sticky hover.
